name: Phase 3 Diagnostics
on:
  push:
    branches: [feat/phase-3-auth-rbac]
    paths: [.github/workflows/phase-3-diagnostics.yml]
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  diagnose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: feat/phase-3-auth-rbac
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
      - run: flutter pub get
      - name: Capture analyzer and test output
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/phases
          set +e
          flutter analyze > /tmp/analyze.txt 2>&1
          ANALYZE_EXIT=$?
          flutter test > /tmp/test.txt 2>&1
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          {
            echo "ANALYZE_EXIT=$ANALYZE_EXIT"
            cat /tmp/analyze.txt
            echo
            echo "TEST_EXIT=$TEST_EXIT"
            cat /tmp/test.txt
          } > docs/phases/PHASE_3_DIAGNOSTICS.txt
      - uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "ci(phase-3): capture diagnostics"
          branch: feat/phase-3-auth-rbac
